#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-necessary environment probe: which PPTX libraries are available."""

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Append a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Implements the pptx skill ooxml.md 'Adding a New Slide' procedure directly on the
OOXML package (zip): create the slide part, register it in [Content_Types].xml,
presentation.xml.rels, presentation.xml sldIdLst, and bump docProps/app.xml.
The new slide inherits the deck's theme (dark1 text color, accent1 bar, major font)
and reuses a placeholder-free slide layout so it matches the report's design.
"""
import os
import re
import zipfile

TARGET_TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"
EMU_IN = 914400
SLIDE_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
LAYOUT_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"
SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"


def find_input():
    if os.path.exists("Q4_financial_report.pptx"):
        return "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
    for f in os.listdir("."):
        if re.fullmatch(r"Q4_financial_report.*\.pptx", f, re.I):
            return f
    raise SystemExit("Q4_financial_report.pptx not found in workspace")


def read_text(zf, name):
    try:
        return zf.read(name).decode("utf-8")
    except KeyError:
        return None


def theme_colors(zf):
    dk1, accent, font = "222222", "2F5496", "Arial"
    xml = read_text(zf, "ppt/theme/theme1.xml")
    if xml:
        def pick(tag):
            m = re.search(
                r'<a:%s>\s*<a:(?:srgbClr val="([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})"|sysClr[^>]*lastClr="([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})")' % tag,
                xml,
            )
            return (m.group(1) or m.group(2)).upper() if m else None

        dk1 = pick("dk1") or dk1
        accent = pick("accent1") or accent
        m = re.search(r'<a:majorFont>\s*<a:latin typeface="([^"]+)"', xml)
        if m:
            font = m.group(1).replace('"', "")
    return dk1, accent, font


def slide_size(zf):
    xml = read_text(zf, "ppt/presentation.xml") or ""
    m = re.search(r'<p:sldSz[^>]*cx="(\d+)"[^>]*cy="(\d+)"', xml)
    return (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))) if m else (12192000, 6858000)


def pick_layout(zf):
    layouts = sorted(
        (n for n in zf.namelist() if re.fullmatch(r"ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout\d+\.xml", n)),
        key=lambda n: int(re.search(r"\d+", n).group()),
    )
    if not layouts:
        return None
    blank = [n for n in layouts if "<p:ph" not in (read_text(zf, n) or "")]
    if blank:
        for n in blank:
            if re.search(r'cSld name="[^"]*[Bb]lank', read_text(zf, n) or ""):
                return n
        return blank[0]
    nums = sorted(
        int(m.group(1))
        for m in (re.fullmatch(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml", n) for n in zf.namelist())
        if m
    )
    if nums:
        rels = read_text(zf, "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % nums[-1]) or ""
        m = re.search(
            r'Type="%s"[^>]*Target="\.\./slideLayouts/(slideLayout\d+\.xml)"' % re.escape(LAYOUT_REL_TYPE),
            rels,
        )
        if m:
            return "ppt/slideLayouts/" + m.group(1)
    return layouts[0]


def build_slide(cx, cy, dk1, accent, font):
    tx, ty = int(cx * 0.06), int(cy / 2 - 0.8 * EMU_IN)
    tw, th = int(cx * 0.88), int(1.6 * EMU_IN)
    bw = int(2.5 * EMU_IN)
    bx, by, bh = (cx - bw) // 2, ty + th + int(0.18 * EMU_IN), int(0.05 * EMU_IN)
    return (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" '
        'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" '
        'xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">\n'
        "  <p:cSld>\n"
        "    <p:spTree>\n"
        '      <p:nvGrpSpPr><p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/><p:cNvGrpSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:grpSpPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/><a:chOff x="0" y="0"/><a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/></a:xfrm></p:grpSpPr>\n'
        "      <p:sp>\n"
        '        <p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouText"/><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvSpPr>\n'
        "        <p:spPr>\n"
        '          <a:xfrm><a:off x="%d" y="%d"/><a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/></a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>\n'
        "        </p:spPr>\n"
        "        <p:txBody>\n"
        '          <a:bodyPr anchor="ctr" lIns="0" tIns="0" rIns="0" bIns="0"/>\n'
        "          <a:lstStyle/>\n"
        "          <a:p>\n"
        '            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>\n'
        "            <a:r>\n"
        '              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="3600" b="1" dirty="0" typeface="%s">\n'
        '                <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="%s"/></a:solidFill>\n'
        "              </a:rPr>\n"
        '              <a:t xml:space="preserve">%s</a:t>\n'
        "            </a:r>\n"
        '            <a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="3600" dirty="0"/>\n'
        "          </a:p>\n"
        "        </p:txBody>\n"
        "      </p:sp>\n"
        "      <p:sp>\n"
        '        <p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="3" name="AccentBar"/><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvSpPr>\n'
        "        <p:spPr>\n"
        '          <a:xfrm><a:off x="%d" y="%d"/><a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/></a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>\n'
        '          <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="%s"/></a:solidFill>\n'
        "          <a:ln><a:noFill/></a:ln>\n"
        "        </p:spPr>\n"
        '        <p:txBody><a:bodyPr/><a:lstStyle/><a:p><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody>\n'
        "      </p:sp>\n"
        "    </p:spTree>\n"
        "  </p:cSld>\n"
        "  <p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr>\n"
        "</p:sld>\n"
    ) % (tx, ty, tw, th, font, dk1, TARGET_TEXT, bx, by, bw, bh, accent)


def insert_before(xml, marker, fragment):
    idx = xml.rfind(marker)
    if idx == -1:
        raise RuntimeError("marker not found in part: %s" % marker)
    return xml[:idx] + fragment + xml[idx:]


def main():
    path = find_input()
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            names = zin.namelist()
            nums = sorted(
                int(m.group(1))
                for m in (re.fullmatch(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml", n) for n in names)
                if m
            )
            new_num = max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1
            slide_part = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num

            ct = read_text(zin, "[Content_Types].xml")
            rels = read_text(zin, "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
            pres = read_text(zin, "ppt/presentation.xml")
            app = read_text(zin, "docProps/app.xml")
            if ct is None or rels is None or pres is None:
                raise RuntimeError("required package parts missing")

            layout = pick_layout(zin)
            layout_name = os.path.basename(layout) if layout else None
            cx, cy = slide_size(zin)
            dk1, accent, font = theme_colors(zin)

            rid = max([int(m) for m in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels)], default=0) + 1
            sid = max([int(m) for m in re.findall(r'<p:sldId\b[^>]*\bid="(\d+)"', pres)], default=255) + 1

            new_ct = insert_before(
                ct, "</Types>",
                '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>\n' % (slide_part, SLIDE_CT),
            )
            new_rels = insert_before(
                rels, "</Relationships>",
                '<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="%s" Target="slides/slide%d.xml"/>\n' % (rid, SLIDE_REL_TYPE, new_num),
            )
            new_pres = insert_before(
                pres, "</p:sldIdLst>",
                '<p:sldId id="%d" r:id="rId%d"/>' % (sid, rid),
            )
            new_app = app
            if app is not None:
                new_app = re.sub(
                    r"<Slides>(\d+)</Slides>",
                    lambda m: "<Slides>%d</Slides>" % (int(m.group(1)) + 1),
                    app,
                )

            slide_xml = build_slide(cx, cy, dk1, accent, font)
            slide_rels = None
            if layout:
                slide_rels = (
                    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
                    '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">\n'
                    '  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s" Target="../slideLayouts/%s"/>\n'
                    "</Relationships>\n" % (LAYOUT_REL_TYPE, layout_name)
                )

            for info in zin.infolist():
                data = zin.read(info.filename)
                if info.filename == "[Content_Types].xml":
                    data = new_ct.encode("utf-8")
                elif info.filename == "ppt/presentation.xml":
                    data = new_pres.encode("utf-8")
                elif info.filename == "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels":
                    data = new_rels.encode("utf-8")
                elif info.filename == "docProps/app.xml":
                    data = new_app.encode("utf-8")
                zout.writestr(info, data)
            zout.writestr(slide_part, slide_xml)
            if slide_rels:
                zout.writestr("ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num, slide_rels)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    except Exception:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)
        raise

    # Verify: final slide in the saved file carries the text
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        vpres = read_text(zf, "ppt/presentation.xml")
        vrels = read_text(zf, "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
        ids = re.findall(r'<p:sldId\b[^>]*r:id="(rId\d+)"', vpres)
        last = ids[-1]
        m = re.search(r'Id="%s"[^>]*Target="(slides/slide\d+\.xml)"' % re.escape(last), vrels)
        if not m:
            raise RuntimeError("verification failed: could not resolve final slide part")
        part = "ppt/" + m.group(1)
        vxml = read_text(zf, part)
        if TARGET_TEXT not in vxml:
            raise RuntimeError("verification failed: final slide text missing")
        print(
            "OK: added final slide %s with '%s' to %s; slides %d -> %d"
            % (part, TARGET_TEXT, path, len(ids) - 1, len(ids))
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            new_num = max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1
            slide_part = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num

            ct = read_text(zin, "[Content_Types].xml")
            rels = read_text(zin, "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
            pres = read_text(zin, "ppt/presentation.xml")
            app = read_text(zin, "docProps/app.xml")
            if ct is None or rels is None or pres is None:
                raise RuntimeError("required package parts missing")

            layout = pick_layout(zin)
            layout_name = os.path.basename(layout) if layout else None
            cx, cy = slide_size(zin)
            dk1, accent, font = theme_colors(zin)

            rid = max([int(m) for m in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels)], default=0) + 1
            sid = max([int(m) for m in re.findall(r'<p:sldId\b[^>]*\bid="(\d+)"', pres)], default=255) + 1

            new_ct = insert_before(
                ct, "</Types>",
                '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>\n' % (slide_part, SLIDE_CT),
            )
            new_rels = insert_before(
                rels, "</Relationships>",
                '<Relationship Id="rId%d" Type="%s" Target="slides/slide%d.xml"/>\n' % (rid, SLIDE_REL_TYPE, new_num),
            )
            new_pres = insert_before(
                pres, "</p:sldIdLst>",
                '<p:sldId id="%d" r:id="rId%d"/>' % (sid, rid),
            )
            new_app = app
            if app is not None:
                new_app = re.sub(
                    r"<Slides>(\d+)</Slides>",
                    lambda m: "<Slides>%d</Slides>" % (int(m.group(1)) + 1),
                    app,
                )

            slide_xml = build_slide(cx, cy, dk1, accent, font)
            slide_rels = None
            if layout:
                slide_rels = (
                    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
                    '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">\n'
                    '  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s" Target="../slideLayouts/%s"/>\n'
                    "</Relationships>\n" % (LAYOUT_REL_TYPE, layout_name)
                )

            for info in zin.infolist():
                data = zin.read(info.filename)
                if info.filename == "[Content_Types].xml":
                    data = new_ct.encode("utf-8")
                elif info.filename == "ppt/presentation.xml":
                    data = new_pres.encode("utf-8")
                elif info.filename == "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels":
                    data = new_rels.encode("utf-8")
                elif info.filename == "docProps/app.xml":
                    data = new_app.encode("utf-8")
                zout.writestr(info, data)
            zout.writestr(slide_part, slide_xml)
            if slide_rels:
                zout.writestr("ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num, slide_rels)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    except Exception:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)
        raise

    # Verify: final slide in the saved file carries the text
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        vpres = read_text(zf, "ppt/presentation.xml")
        vrels = read_text(zf, "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
        ids = re.findall(r'<p:sldId\b[^>]*r:id="(rId\d+)"', vpres)
        last = ids[-1]
        m = re.search(r'Id="%s"[^>]*Target="(slides/slide\d+\.xml)"' % re.escape(last), vrels)
        if not m:
            raise RuntimeError("verification failed: could not resolve final slide part")
        part = "ppt/" + m.group(1)
        vxml = read_text(zf, part)
        if TARGET_TEXT not in vxml:
            raise RuntimeError("verification failed: final slide text missing")
        print(
            "OK: added final slide %s with '%s' to %s; slides %d -> %d"
            % (part, TARGET_TEXT, path, len(ids) - 1, len(ids))
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
